groups.rationale: Reviewed merged source ownership and topology for incoming Mila/Porsche client commands, Marshall Notifications and independent Susan relay. Chapters preserve client-only authority, separate Susan database/provider egress and absent fleet placement, with device/provider/native gaps and no new integrated pass.

Reviewed three-fresh-peer concurrent initialization, closed timing records and equivalent batched committed-SQL fixture predicates with original 100-case CI histories and 300-second bounds. Recorded separate 42/42 Covenant scope; timing and batched replays each passed only 1/3, so full Marshall acceptance remains incomplete. Chapter coverage preserves these failures and fleet gaps.

Reviewed exact FreeBSD 0150b6d1 additive admission and default selection with legacy manifest/bundle identity and capability absence preserved. Current-VMM five-scenario qualification, signed publication, fresh-store verification and selected production verifier are recorded separately. Protocol 421-test gate, Covenant 15/15 and forced Dialyzer passed at this source checkpoint; OmniOS selection and native checkpoints remain unchanged.

Reviewed synchronous 100-case image-catalog supervision and exact-placement settled-failure producer cleanup without changing production transitions or original test bounds. Final Lilly gate passed 652 tests, Covenant 15/15 and forced Dialyzer. Retained native restart still repeats immutable admission without catalog lookup; newly selected FreeBSD fleet and retained-tool acceptance remain independent gaps.

Reviewed private integration AAAA authoritative NODATA/SOA repair with unchanged A destination and name refusals. Clean paired A/AAAA focused execution passed five tests; prior full Audi run was 232/233 with only known out-of-scope Inception failure. Galileo serial fixture gate passed 59 tests, Covenant 4/4 and forced Dialyzer without changing lease bounds. Failed composed fleet replay remains explicit; DNS and BEAM results grant no OAuth or native acceptance.

Reviewed exact current-VMM signed FreeBSD promotion/default constructor while preserving old staging and admission identities. All five scenarios and separate fresh-store production verification passed for FreeBSD; OmniOS four-scenario passes, shutdown-send failure and later earlier-boot failure remain separate with no new admission. Closed SSH and browser/guest failure markers retain original bounds and redact bytes. Composed GitHub fleet replay failed and supplies no fleet acceptance.

Reviewed ADR-0080/0190/0202, overview, evidence review and generated scenarios against the exact checkpoint diff. Accepted rationale and partial statuses remain; FreeBSD publication/selection is distinguished from live deployment, OmniOS failures remain unqualified, and application/focused/native/fleet results retain separate scopes. Coverage and ownership/topology/reference checks do not establish runtime acceptance.
